newsitem.title: USA: C-Cube sees one mln 1997 industry DVD sales.
newsitem.headline: C-Cube sees one mln 1997 industry DVD sales.

text.p: C-Cube Microsystems Inc President and CEO Alexandre Balkanski said he conservatively expects the total market for digital video disk (DVD) machines to hit one million in unit sales in calendar 1997.
"I think DVD conservatively will ship in excess of one million units in calendar year 1997," he told analysts at an American Electronics Association investment conference here.
He said should this target be exceeded significantly, C-Cube's "DVD revenue will exceed video CD by calendar year 1997."
